verdict.rationale: Supabase documents first-party self-hosting via Docker Compose on your own infrastructure for full data control and isolated environments. Its GitHub repo positions the product as built on open-source tools, and the official CLI runs the entire Supabase stack locally or in CI, with hands-on probes confirming headless install and init. A community member asking how hard self-hosting is raises an open question, not concrete counter-evidence. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting docs on feature parity with the managed platform, independent or hands-on corroboration of a production self-hosted deployment, and evidence of agent-driven self-host provisioning beyond the local CLI stack.
